serotype_evidence.notes: Discrepancy with GenomeTrakr - requires tool verification

quality_metrics.collected_by: Pennsylvania State University | Escherichia coli Reference Center

curation.notes: GenomeTrakr isolate ISO000083983 (SEQSEQ000072745). Strain 99.1894. Isolation: missing from canine (1999). Assembly not available - generate locally.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR7042029 && mv data/SRR7042029_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR7042029_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected O6:H1 (per GenomeTrakr) but NCBI BioSample says O119. PARTIAL acceptable if either serotype detected. Verify with both tools. Expected ExPEC virulence: pap, hlyA, cnf1. Likely ST73 or ST127.
validation_instructions.mlst: Run mlst with 'ecoli' scheme. Expected ST73 (phylogroup B2). Accept exact match.

notes: Classic UPEC serotype O6:H1, typically ST73 phylogroup B2. Canine isolate 1999 from E. coli Reference Center. NCBI metadata shows "O119" but GenomeTrakr GIMS database shows "O6:H1" - serotype discrepancy requires verification with typing tools.
